import random
import bisect
import statistics
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(n, value):
    numbers = [random.random() for _ in range(n)]

    average = statistics.mean(numbers) if numbers else 0
    greater_than_average = [x for x in numbers if x > average]
    count_ge_value = sum(1 for x in numbers if x >= value)

    sorted_numbers = sorted(numbers)
    plt.figure()
    plt.plot(sorted_numbers, marker='o')
    plt.title('Sorted Random Numbers')
    plt.xlabel('Index')
    plt.ylabel('Value')
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.show()

    return greater_than_average, count_ge_value
